fullPassage: According to educational psychologist Susan Engel, curiosity begins to decrease as young as four years old. By the time we are adults, we have fewer questions and more default settings. As Henry James put it, "Disinterested curiosity is past, the mental grooves and channels set." The decline in curiosity can be traced in the development of the brain through childhood. Though smaller than the adult brain, the infant brain contains millions more neural connections. The wiring, however, is a mess; the lines of communication between infant neurons are far less efficient than between those in the adult brain. The baby's perception of the world is consequently both intensely rich and wildly disordered. As children absorb more evidence from the world around them, certain possibilities become much more likely and more useful and harden into knowledge or beliefs. The neural pathways that enable those beliefs become faster and more automatic, while the ones that the child doesn't use regularly are pruned away.

❌ ② (A) 풍부한 — (B) 부유한: (A)의 rich는 사업가 맥락에서 부유한
❌ ③ (A) 부유한 — (B) (맛이) 진한: (B)의 rich는 인식이 풍부한이지 맛이 아님
❌ ④ (A) 비옥한 — (B) 부유한: (A)는 비옥한이 아닌 부유한
det.tip: rich: ① 부유한(돈) ② 풍부한(내용) ③ (맛이) 진한 ④ 비옥한(토양)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a strong desire to know or learn about something"

det.korean: curiosity=호기심 (무언가를 알고 배우려는 강한 욕구)
det.analysis:
❌ ① decline(감소): 줄어듦으로 정의와 무관
❌ ② perception(인식): 지각으로 정의와 다름
❌ ③ knowledge(지식): 이미 아는 것으로 '알고 싶어 하는 욕구'와 다름
✅ ④ curiosity(호기심): 무언가를 알고 배우려는 강한 욕구로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: curiosity = 호기심. a strong desire to know or learn이 핵심 단서

questions.passage: The decline in curiosity can be __________ (trace) in the development of the brain through childhood. The infant brain contains millions more neural connections.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: can be + 과거분사 traced: 수동태 '추적될 수 있다'
det.analysis: 'The decline ... can be __________ in the development'에서 조동사 can + be 뒤에 수동태를 이루는 과거분사가 필요하다. '추적되는' 수동 의미이므로 동사 trace를 과거분사 traced로 바꾼다. trace → traced
det.tip: can be + p.p.(수동태): can be traced(추적될 수 있다)

questions.passage: As children absorb more evidence, certain possibilities harden into beliefs. The neural pathways that enable those beliefs become faster and more __________ (automatically), while the unused ones are pruned away.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: become의 보어 자리이므로 형용사 automatic (부사 automatically → 형용사 automatic)
det.analysis: 'become faster and more __________'에서 become의 보어로 faster와 병렬되는 형용사가 필요하다. 부사 automatically(자동적으로)를 형용사 automatic(자동적인)으로 바꾼다. automatically → automatic
det.tip: become + 형용사(보어): become faster and more automatic

questions.passage: According to educational psychologist Susan Engel, curiosity begins to decrease as young as four years old. By the time we are adults, we have __________. As Henry James put it, "Disinterested curiosity is past, the mental grooves and channels set." The decline in curiosity can be traced in the development of the brain through childhood. Though smaller than the adult brain, the infant brain contains millions more neural connections. The wiring, however, is a mess; the lines of communication between infant neurons are far less efficient than between those in the adult brain. The baby's perception of the world is consequently both intensely rich and wildly disordered. As children absorb more evidence from the world around them, certain possibilities become much more likely and more useful and harden into knowledge or beliefs. The neural pathways that enable those beliefs become faster and more automatic, while the ones that the child doesn't use regularly are pruned away.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fewer questions and more default settings=더 적은 질문과 더 많은 정해진 기본값 — 성인이 되면 호기심이 줄어든 상태
det.analysis:
❌ ① far more curiosity than ever before(훨씬 많은 호기심): 호기심이 줄어든다는 논지와 반대
✅ ② fewer questions and more default settings(더 적은 질문과 더 많은 기본값): 성인이 되면 질문이 줄고 고정된 사고가 늘어난다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ a much stronger desire to explore(훨씬 강한 탐구 욕구): 호기심 감소와 반대
❌ ④ completely new ways of thinking(완전히 새로운 사고방식): 고정된 사고와 반대
det.tip: By the time we are adults, we have fewer questions and more default settings

As children absorb more evidence from the world around them, certain possibilities become much more likely and more useful and __________. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: harden into knowledge or beliefs=지식이나 믿음으로 굳어진다 — 아이가 증거를 흡수하면서 특정 가능성이 굳어지는 과정
det.analysis:
❌ ① disappear from the brain entirely(뇌에서 완전히 사라진다): 굳어진다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② remain forever uncertain and open(영원히 불확실하게 열려 있다): 굳어진다는 맥락과 반대
✅ ③ harden into knowledge or beliefs(지식이나 믿음으로 굳어진다): 아이가 증거를 흡수할수록 특정 가능성이 더 유용해지며 지식·믿음으로 굳어진다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ turn into pure imagination(순수한 상상으로 변한다): 지식·믿음과 반대 방향
det.tip: certain possibilities ... harden into knowledge or beliefs
